author: lukepne
body:
Username: Lukepne
Reason I was banned: The reason i was banned was for hacking. I started playing Minecraft around a week before i found your server so i was new to the whole thing. Around 2 weeks - 1 month after playing avicus i heard about 'hacking', Of course only just starting to play the game i wasn't very good, therefore i instantly wondered where i could find these hacks. I soon found out where and downloaded them. Around 2 weeks after playing on your server i decided to give them a try, On the first day of trying them out i was banned. 
Why i should be unbanned (my opinion): I think i should be unbanned because I've learned my lesson. I realize that by using hacks it ruins the game for everyone else. Its been around 5 months since i was was banned and i was hoping that that's a just punishment. I've deleted my hacks and found that by playing legit you get a sense of respect of other players. I love your server and really want to be a part of the community. Please accept my appeal. Thank you for your time.

replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the fact that you have served a significant amount of time banned, and you seem to have learned your lesson, I am going to appeal you.
Make sure that you read the rules before joining the server again.
Welcome back!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
